item.title: Contracts For July 8, 2026
item.description:
ARMY

Lockheed Martin Corp., Fort Worth, Texas, was awarded a $490,000,000 firm-fixed-price contract for F-35 sustainment services. Work will be performed in Fort Worth, Texas, with an estimated completion date of July 2029.

Raytheon Co., Tucson, Arizona, has been awarded a $1.2 billion contract for production of interceptor missiles. Work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona.

NAVY

Small Boat Works Inc., Norfolk, Virginia, was awarded a $12,000,000 contract for harbor maintenance craft. Work will be performed in Norfolk, Virginia.
